description: The post-change counterpart to prepareChange: use this AFTER changes are made to assess what you actually changed and what to verify before finishing. Defaults to the uncommitted working tree; also supports staged changes or a base-branch range. Answers: what might break? which tests should run? are there possible contract changes? `doneCheck` lists each use of a changed declaration that the diff left as it was (`openSites`: under the symbol and why it counts, then the file, then `line: code`); uses that rarely break (a TypeScript annotation, a read of a widened key) are one line per symbol with a count, and focus "rarely" lists them. Status is open, clear or not_assessed. It compares text and compiles nothing, so clear is not proof. `coChangeOpen` lists the files that usually change with the touched files (git history, any language) and were left alone. The default format "compact" returns text with just what to act on (risk, open sites, the tests that use a changed symbol, contracts with before and after, consumer files), no symbol ids; pass focus "done", "rarely", "tests" or "risk" for only that part, paged with offset; pass format "full" for every detail, including symbol ids, affected modules, recommendations and the per-check structure (`coChangeCheck.openFiles`). For pre-change planning (before writing code), use prepareChange instead. For full PR review with quality gates, use reviewPR.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for comparison when using git diff

depth.description: Maximum depth for transitive impact analysis (1-4)

diffContent.description: Raw git diff content. If empty, uses current working tree diff

focus.description: Compact only: return just the part you need. 'done': open sites and co-change files left alone (is the change finished?). 'rarely': the open sites that rarely break, which the other views count per symbol. 'tests': affected test files with test names and runTests, a command that runs them. 'risk': score, riskFactors, contract changes, consumer files. Omit for all sections. The summary always covers everything

format.description: Response format: 'compact' (default) returns text with what to act on (risk, doneCheck open sites by symbol and file as line: code, the test files that use a changed symbol with test names, contracts with before and after, direct consumer files), a fraction of the size; 'full' returns JSON with all details including symbol ids

includeTests.description: Count test code as consumers and as changed symbols. Tests using a changed symbol are in affectedTests either way

limit.description: With focus 'done', 'rarely' or 'tests': at most this many open sites (default 50) or test files (default 20)

offset.description: With focus 'done', 'rarely' or 'tests': skip this many open sites or test files. The response's 'more' says the next offset

staged.description: If true and no diffContent provided, analyze only staged changes (--cached)

strict.description: Fail if SCIP index is stale

name: assessChange
